execution: Which language and process interpret the input?
Which statements, conditions and repetitions run in this call?

rules: Define each new term in Korean with its components, concrete operation and an environment example; preserve English programming terms.
Never explain through metaphor or analogy.
Use actual native schemas and supported arguments; do not assume any particular CLI or tool runtime.
Do not equate official support, effective configuration, tool exposure, execution and observed target effect.
Read only the relevant questions; a short answer does not require this whole checklist.
